senses.gloss: m., only in constr. בֵּין, בינת־ (b. h.; preced., cmp. ביין, באיין) something split, or placed between; prep. between, among.—אין בין … ל there is no difference betw. … and … Meg. I, 5; a. fr.—בין השמשות (abbr. בה״ש) at twilight, dusk; v. בֵּי.
units: Ab. V, 6; a. fr.—… ב׳ … ב׳ both … as well as … B. Kam. IV, 3; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 23a:3">Yeb. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ אומרים לו וכ׳</he> whether the law says to thy father …, or &c.
Koh. R. to VII, 11 בין ווי לוה וכ׳ owing to the difference between vay (woe) and vah (ah), R. J. escaped.—דברים שֶׁבֵּינוֹ לְבֵינָהּ private affairs concerning him (the husband) and her (the wife).
Ned. 79ᵇ; a. fr.—Du. בֵּינַיִים, בֵּנַיִים, בֵּינְתַּיִים, בֵּנְתַּיִם (for בֵּינוֹתַיִם) between two, among, amid.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 4:6">Gen. R. s. 4</cite> <he>ביניים ובינתיים</he> in the very centre.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:7:8">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵇ</cite> top.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:1:2">Y. Maasr. I, beg. 48ᶜ</cite> <he>טול מבנת׳</he> take from what is between the two, i.e. qualifications common to both; a. fr.—Constr. <he>בֵּינֵי־</he>.
<cite ref="Niddah 67b:13">Nidd. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>מפסקת בֵּינֵיהֶן</he> intervening between; a. fr.
